notes.title: Astral Towers released on Steam for the first time
notes.content:
Astral Towers is a card game with "one turn - one action" mechanic - like Spectromancer. This is mostly an adventure game: there are 89 missions at 2 difficulty levels. 

The original game was made in 2011, it was English-only and designed for 1366x768 screen resolution, which was OK for WinXP, but looks ugly on Vista and above. Now the remastered edition has improved graphics designed for up to 4K screen resolution. 
Other changes are:

 Improved UI and visualization.
 Full support for Russian language.
 Improved campaign balance based on actual stats.
 Steam achievements.

I hope you'll like it and post a review! :-)

Game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/983450/Astral_Towers/

notes.title: Free gold with the Goodnight app
notes.content:
Now it is possible to get in-game gold for free with Goodnight app.
Goodnight app mines GOLD using the power of your CPU (when it is idle). The more powerful your CPU is - the more gold you get.
The app is safe for PC, it doesn’t reboot it and doesn’t significantly increase the power consumption. 
You can run the app whenever you want.
Get a 50 gold bonus for the first launch.

How it works:

 Download and install the Goodnight app.
 Sign up with your email address used in the game.
 Press "Start" to start farming gold and get 50 gold bonus. You can withdraw the gold to the game at any time.

notes.title: New version - 1.2!
notes.content:
Game updated to version 1.2
What's new:


 View duel replays (all duels are recorded and stored on the server)
 Some cards are changed (see full list on the game forum)
 Inactive players (not played within last 30 days) lose 1% of their fame every week
 Magister title now gives +2 life in Custom Decks mode (regardless of the guild level)
 Caravan cooldown reset is made cheaper
 3 new bots added: level 1, 2 and 3.
 Bugfix: wrong deck selection during the caravan process.

ATTENTION! By default your replays are visible to all players. If you don't want other players to access replays of your duels with custom decks, please open game settings and set a tick to make them private. Private replays are visible to you and members of your guild (except recruits).

ACTION: price for daily premium decreased by 40%!

notes.title: New version - 1.12!
notes.content:
- Spanish translation added - big respect to Hansi Rojas!
- French translation updated - many thanks to Alexandre Rossi.
- Guild bonus "Investments" nerfed.
- Bugfix: rare freeze during card effects fixed.
- Interface: player status autoupdate in the player search results box.
- Interface: more convenient card upgrading.
- Cards: astral price for Armageddon increased by 10.

notes.title: Game updated to version 1.11
notes.content:
Main changes:
- Support for user-contributed translations, packages for French and Ukrainian languages included.
- Bug fixed: wrong avatar size/placement.
- Bug fixed: caravan battle doesn't start.
- Some UI improvements.

Cards were not changed.
How to make your own language pack

notes.title: Game updated to version 1.01
notes.content:
Main changes:

Now the second part of the campaign unlocks upon reaching level-5 in any mode. It is made easier, so level-5 players can pass it.
Search Players feature improved.
Some cards were changed (full list below).
Some bugs were fixed.


CHANGED CARDS:
Chaos:
  Tenacious Ooze, +1 attack (to 6)
  Harpy, +5 astral cost (to 85)
  Chaotic Wave, +10 astral cost (to 40)
  Energy Wave, -10 astral cost (to 30)

Life:
  Seeker of Knowledge, -15 astral cost (to 10)

Death:
  Final Sacrifice, +10 astral cost (to 80)
